  • Method Details

    • createArrow

      public static Entity createArrow(com.badlogic.gdx.math.Vector2 position, com.badlogic.gdx.math.Vector2 direction, int damage, Entity owner)
      Creates a player arrow that travels in a straight line and hits enemies or obstacles. Kept separate from createRangedArrow(com.badlogic.gdx.math.Vector2, boolean, float, float, int, float, short) below because player arrows route damage through the player's combat stats.
      Parameters:
      position - where the arrow starts, in world units
      direction - the direction of travel; must not be the zero vector
      damage - the damage dealt on a hit
      owner - the entity that fired the arrow
      Returns:
      the new arrow, or null if any argument is invalid

    • createRangedArrow

      public static Entity createRangedArrow(com.badlogic.gdx.math.Vector2 position, boolean movingRight, float speed, float maxRange, int damage, float knockback, short targetLayer)
      Creates an arrow projectile for a ranged enemy attack (e.g. a skeleton ranger): a real entity that flies out, only deals damage on actual (Box2D) contact with targetLayer, is blocked by anything on PhysicsLayer.OBSTACLE in its way, and despawns once it has travelled maxRange world units without hitting anything.

      Movement is a straight horizontal line (x-axis only) at a constant speed by default, via StraightLineMovementStrategy - see ProjectileComponent for how to swap in a different movement type later (a slower "follow" arrow, a lobbed/bow-arc shot, ...) without changing anything here.

      Parameters:
      position - spawn position (world units) - typically just in front of the shooter, not its exact center, so the arrow doesn't spawn inside the shooter's own collider.
      movingRight - true to fire in the +x direction (target is to the right), false for -x.
      speed - travel speed in world units/second.
      maxRange - maximum distance the arrow can travel before despawning; should normally match the firing RangedAttackComponent's configured range.
      damage - damage dealt to whatever the arrow hits on targetLayer.
      knockback - knockback magnitude applied on a successful hit; 0f disables it.
      targetLayer - the physics layer the arrow deals damage to on contact (e.g. PhysicsLayer.PLAYER).
      Returns:
      the arrow entity, not yet registered with the entity service.

    • createAimedArrow

      public static Entity createAimedArrow(com.badlogic.gdx.math.Vector2 position, com.badlogic.gdx.math.Vector2 direction, float speed, float maxRange, int damage, float knockback, short targetLayer)
      Creates an enemy arrow that flies in a straight line along direction (for example from a Harpy to the player's centre), so a shooter above or below its target can still hit it. Everything else matches createRangedArrow(com.badlogic.gdx.math.Vector2, boolean, float, float, int, float, short): damage only on real contact with targetLayer, stopped by PhysicsLayer.OBSTACLE, despawned after maxRange.

      The sprite is mirrored when the shot travels leftward, as for the x-only arrow. Rotating the sprite to match a diagonal flight is not done here.

      Parameters:
      position - where the arrow's bottom-left corner starts
      direction - direction of travel; must not be null, zero length or non-finite
      speed - travel speed in world units/second; must be positive
      maxRange - maximum distance travelled before despawning; must be positive
      damage - damage dealt on a hit
      knockback - knockback magnitude on a hit; 0 disables it
      targetLayer - physics layer the arrow can damage
      Returns:
      the arrow entity, not yet registered with the entity service
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if position or direction is invalid, or speed or maxRange is not positive

    • createLightning

      public static Entity createLightning(com.badlogic.gdx.math.Vector2 targetPosition, float skyOffset, float speed, int damage, int freezeTicks, short targetLayer)
      Creates a lightning bolt that spawns in the sky above a target position and falls straight down. On contact with targetLayer it deals damage and freezes the target via the target's SpeedEffectComponent (through the "applySpeedEffect" event).
      Parameters:
      targetPosition - position of the target at the moment of the strike. Sampled once, so a moving target can dodge.
      skyOffset - how far above the target the bolt spawns.
      speed - fall speed in world units/second.
      damage - damage on hit; 0 for a pure freeze.
      freezeTicks - how many ticks the target is frozen for (about 60 per second).
      targetLayer - physics layer the bolt hits (e.g. PhysicsLayer.PLAYER).
      Returns:
      the bolt entity, not yet registered with the entity service.
